# Introduction

## Load packages
```{r}
library(rprojroot)
root <- has_file(".Bayesian-Workflow-root")$make_fix_file()
library(cmdstanr)
library(brms)
options(brms.backend = "cmdstanr", mc.cores = 4)
library(posterior)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(bayesplot)
theme_set(bayesplot::theme_default(base_family = "sans", base_size = 16))
library(marginaleffects)

print_stan_file <- function(file) {
  code <- readLines(file)
  if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress")) &
        identical(knitr::opts_current$get("results"), "asis")) {
    # In render: emit as-is so Pandoc/Quarto does syntax highlighting
    block <- paste0("```stan", "\n", paste(code, collapse = "\n"), "\n", "```")
    knitr::asis_output(block)
  } else {
    writeLines(code)
  }
}
```
# Bioassay data

```{r}
df_bioassay <- read.csv("data/bioassay.csv")
```
Data plotted with base R
```{r}
with(df_bioassay,
plot(dose, deaths, xlab = "dose log(g/ml)", ylab = "# of deaths", pch = 19, cex = 1.5, bty = "l"))
```

Data plotted with ggplot

```{r}
df_bioassay |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = dose, y = deaths)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    labs(x = "Dose log(g/ml)", y = "# of deaths")
```

Data as list for CmdStanR

```{r}
bioassay_data <- with(df_bioassay,
list(J = nrow(df_bioassay),
x = dose,
N = batch_size,
y = deaths))
```

# Stan models and inference

Stan model 0 (without priors)

```{r}
mod0 <- cmdstan_model("bioassay0.stan", pedantic=TRUE)
```

Printing and graphing the fitted model

```{r}
fit0 <- mod0$sample(data=bioassay_data, refresh=0)
print(fit0)
```
